front: What are the four steps of the steering loop?

back: The family says which wire is at fault, so the fix changes that wire and not the model.
front: Why name the family before choosing a fix?

back: A harness part written to be removed when a newer model no longer needs it, with a measure before removal.
A rule that names a function the code no longer has, so the model follows a stale map.
front: What does entropy look like in a rules file?

back: A check runs on every change; a reminder depends on someone remembering to read the file.
front: Why a mechanical check and not a reminder?

back: Fast checks, clear errors, a readable structure and docs that act as a short map.
